title: Plant Scents
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.prompt: “A substance released to help a plant defend itself”
questions.translation: 一種被釋放出來、幫助植物保護自己的物質。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph B第一句：

“The release of volatiles from vegetative parts of the plant is familiar, although until recently the physiological functions of these chemicals were less clear and had received much less attention from scientists.”
中文意思：
植物營養部位釋放揮發物這件事並不陌生，雖然直到近年，這些化學物的生理功能仍較不清楚，也較少得到科學家注意。
最後一句：

“Interestingly, the profile of emitted tobacco volatiles is different at night than during the day, and it is the nocturnal blend, rich in several (Z)-3-hexen-1-ol esters, that is most effective in repelling the night-active H. virescens moths.”
中文意思：
有趣的是，煙草釋放出的揮發物在日間和夜間組合不同，而富含數種 (Z)-3-hexen-1-ol 酯類的夜間混合物，最能驅趕夜間活動的 H. virescens 蛾。
題目定位詞是 “substance released”、“defend itself”。原文中可找 released / emitted / exudes /deters / defence mechanism。Paragraph B 先講 pine tree injured 後釋放 resin，再講 green leaf volatile 阻止 moths 在受傷煙草上產卵。
關鍵證據一：
“When the trunk of a pine tree is injured—for example, when a beetle tries to burrow into it—it exudes a very smelly resin.”
中文意思：
當松樹樹幹受傷時，例如甲蟲試圖鑽入樹幹，它會滲出一種氣味很強的樹脂。
關鍵證據二：
“The heavier C20 terpenes, called diterpenes, are glue-like and can cover and immobilise insects as they plug the hole.”
中文意思：
較重的 C20 萜類，即二萜，像膠水一樣，可以在堵住洞口時覆蓋並固定昆蟲，使牠們動彈不得。
題目中的 “substance released” 對應 resin / terpenes / green leaf volatile；“help a plant defend itself” 對應 cover and immobilise insects 或 deters females from laying eggs。B 段明確講植物受傷後釋放物質作防衛，所以答案是 B。
C 段也講 defence，但它偏向 indirect defences，即吸引其他昆蟲來幫忙。Question 1 問的是一種釋放出的物質本身幫助植物防衛，B 段的 resin / terpenes 更直接。
目標段落：Paragraph A第一句：
“Everyone is familiar with scented flowers, and many people have heard that floral odours help the plant attract pollinators.”
中文意思：
人人都熟悉有香味的花，很多人也聽過花香能幫助植物吸引授粉者。
最後一句：
“As for flower scents that we can detect with our noses, bouquets that attract moths and butterflies generally smell ‘sweet’, and those that attract certain flies seem ‘rotten’ to us.”
中文意思：
至於人類鼻子能聞到的花香，吸引蛾和蝴蝶的氣味通常聞起來是「甜的」，吸引某些蒼蠅的氣味在我們聞起來則像「腐爛」的味道。
題目定位詞是 “scent”、“pollination”。原文直接有 “floral odours help the plant attract pollinators”。Pollinators 就是替植物授粉的生物，例如 moths, butterflies, flies。
關鍵證據：
“This common notion is mostly correct, but it is surprising how little scientific proof of it exists.”
中文意思：
這個常見觀念大致正確，但令人驚訝的是，支持它的科學證據其實很少。
這裡的 “common notion” 指前一句 “floral odours help the plant attract pollinators”。題目把
“attract pollinators” 概括成 “helping a plant’s pollination”。A 段就是全篇中最直接處理花香和授粉關係的段落。
D 段也談 pollination，但重點是 agricultural crops 的經濟影響。Question 2 只問基本概念 “scent helping pollination”，A 段首句已直接提供答案。

questions.translation: 涉及香味的實際基因實驗。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph F第一句：
“Genetic manipulation of the scent will also benefit the floriculture industry.”
中文意思：
對香味進行基因操控也會惠及花卉產業。
最後一句：
“Similar experiments in tobacco used genes for other monoterpene synthases, such as the one that produces limonene, but gave similar results.”
中文意思：
在煙草上進行的類似實驗使用了其他單萜合成酶基因，例如產生 limonene 的基因，但結果相似。
題目定位詞是 “genetic experiments”、“fragrance”。Paragraph F 出現 “Genetic manipulation”、
“experiments”、“petunia and carnation”、“linalool synthase gene”、“tobacco used genes”。
關鍵證據：“Some work has already begun in this area, as several groups have created petunia and carnation plants that express the linalool synthase gene from C. breweri.”
中文意思：
這方面已有一些工作開始，因為幾個研究小組已經創造出能表達 C. breweri 的 linalool synthase基因的 petunia 和 carnation 植株。
這句的 “created petunia and carnation plants” 顯示這不是單純構想，而是已經進行的實驗。題目中的 “practical genetic experiments” 對應 “some work has already begun” 和 “created plants that express the gene”。
G 段講 “next generation of experiments, already in progress”，但重點是未來更精細的 schemes。Question 3 問 practical genetic experiments involving fragrance，F 段有具體植物、具體基因和具體結果，因此最合適。

questions.prompt: “A plant scent attracting an herbivore’s natural enemy for protection”
questions.translation: 植物氣味吸引食草動物的天敵，藉此保護植物。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph C第一句：
“Herbivore-induced volatiles often serve as indirect defences.”
中文意思：
由食草動物誘發的揮發物經常作為間接防衛。
最後一句：
“It appears that methyl salicylate is both an attractant and a reward offered by the tree to get the ants to perform this valuable deterrent role.”
中文意思：
看來 methyl salicylate 既是吸引物，也是樹提供給螞蟻的獎勵，用來讓螞蟻執行這種有價值的嚇阻角色。
題目定位詞是 “attracting”、“herbivore’s natural enemy”、“protection”。Paragraph C 有 “attract a variety of predatory insects”、“parasitic wasps”、“parasites of the eggs”、“ants patrol young leaves”。
關鍵證據：
“These signals attract a variety of predatory insects that prey on the plant-eaters.”
中文意思：
這些訊號會吸引各種捕食性昆蟲，而這些昆蟲會捕食吃植物的動物。
再看例子：
“For example, some parasitic wasps can detect the volatile signature of a damaged plant and will lay their eggs inside the offending caterpillar.”
中文意思：
例如，有些寄生蜂能偵測受損植物的揮發物特徵，並會把卵產在造成傷害的毛蟲體內。
題目中的 “herbivore’s natural enemy” 對應 predatory insects / parasitic wasps；“plant scent attracting” 對應 volatile signals attract；“for protection” 對應 indirect defences。答案是 C。
B 段是直接防衛，C 段是間接防衛。Question 4 的關鍵在 “natural enemy”，所以應找能吸引捕食者或寄生者的段落。

questions.prompt: “There is little evidence to support the idea that scent attracts pollinators.”
questions.translation: 支持「氣味吸引授粉者」這個觀點的證據很少。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph A第一句：
“Everyone is familiar with scented flowers, and many people have heard that floral odours help the plant attract pollinators.”
中文意思：
人人都熟悉有香味的花，很多人也聽過花香能幫助植物吸引授粉者。
最後一句：
“As for flower scents that we can detect with our noses, bouquets that attract moths and butterflies generally smell ‘sweet’, and those that attract certain flies seem ‘rotten’ to us.”
中文意思：
至於人類鼻子能聞到的花香，吸引蛾和蝴蝶的氣味通常聞起來是「甜的」，吸引某些蒼蠅的氣味在我們聞起來則像「腐爛」的味道。
題目定位詞是 “little evidence”、“scent attracts pollinators”。A 段第二句直接出現 “how little scientific proof”。
關鍵證據：
“This common notion is mostly correct, but it is surprising how little scientific proof of it exists.”
中文意思：
這個常見觀念大致正確，但令人驚訝的是，支持它的科學證據其實很少。
題目的 “little evidence” 對應原文 “little scientific proof”。“the idea that scent attracts pollinators”對應前一句 “floral odours help the plant attract pollinators”。原文方向和題目一致，所以答案是TRUE。
原文同時說 “mostly correct”，所以不能誤解為這個觀點錯了。題目只說證據少，沒有說觀點錯，所以 TRUE。

questions.prompt: “Heliothis virescens will not eat tobacco leaves on which they have laid eggs.”
questions.translation: Heliothis virescens 不會吃牠們已經產卵的煙草葉。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph B第一句：

“The release of volatiles from vegetative parts of the plant is familiar, although until recently the physiological functions of these chemicals were less clear and had received much less attention from scientists.”
中文意思：
植物營養部位釋放揮發物這件事並不陌生，雖然直到近年，這些化學物的生理功能仍較不清楚，也較少得到科學家注意。
最後一句：

“Interestingly, the profile of emitted tobacco volatiles is different at night than during the day, and it is the nocturnal blend, rich in several (Z)-3-hexen-1-ol esters, that is most effective in repelling the night-active H. virescens moths.”
中文意思：
有趣的是，煙草釋放出的揮發物在日間和夜間組合不同，而夜間混合物最能驅趕夜間活動的 H. virescens 蛾。
題目定位詞非常強：“Heliothis virescens”、“tobacco”、“laid eggs”。Paragraph B 尾段找到 H. virescens 和 tobacco plants。
關鍵證據：

“For example, (Z)-3-hexenyl acetate, which is known as a ‘green leaf volatile’ because it is emitted by many plants upon injury, deters females of the moth Heliothis virescens from laying eggs on injured tobacco plants.”
中文意思：
例如，(Z)-3-hexenyl acetate 被稱為「綠葉揮發物」，因為很多植物受傷時會釋放它；它能阻止Heliothis virescens 雌蛾在受傷的煙草植物上產卵。
原文只說這種揮發物 deters females from laying eggs，即阻止雌蛾產卵。題目多了 “will not eat tobacco leaves” 這個行為，也多了 “on which they have laid eggs” 這個已產卵後的情境。原文沒有說 H. virescens 是否吃那些葉，也沒有說已產卵後會不會吃。
判斷：沒有明確相反證據，所以不能選 FALSE；但題目所需的 eating 行為原文沒有提供，所以答案是NOT GIVEN。
學生容易看到 “laying eggs on injured tobacco plants” 就把 “laid eggs” 連上題目。真正控制答案的是 eat。原文談產卵，不談進食。

questions.prompt: “Ants guard certain plants in the rainforest.”
questions.translation: 螞蟻會守護雨林中的某些植物。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph C第一句：
“Herbivore-induced volatiles often serve as indirect defences.”
中文意思：
由食草動物誘發的揮發物經常作為間接防衛。
最後一句：
“It appears that methyl salicylate is both an attractant and a reward offered by the tree to get the ants to perform this valuable deterrent role.”
中文意思：
看來 methyl salicylate 既是吸引物，也是樹提供給螞蟻的獎勵，用來讓螞蟻執行這種有價值的嚇阻角色。
題目定位詞是 “Ants”、“rainforest”、“guard”。Paragraph C 中有 “rainforest understorey tree Leonardoxa africana” 和 “ants ... patrol young leaves”。
關鍵證據：
“In the rainforest understorey tree Leonardoxa africana, ants of the species Petalomyrmex phylax patrol young leaves and attack any herbivorous insects that they encounter.”
中文意思：
在雨林下層樹 Leonardoxa africana 中，Petalomyrmex phylax 這種螞蟻會巡邏嫩葉，並攻擊牠們遇到的任何食草昆蟲。
題目 “guard certain plants” 對應原文 “patrol young leaves and attack any herbivorous insects”。
“rainforest” 原字重現。雖然原文沒有用 guard，但 patrol and attack 表達了守護功能，所以答案是TRUE。
題目說 “certain plants”，原文只給一種 rainforest understorey tree 作例子。這個範圍很保守，沒有過度概括成 all plants，所以 TRUE 成立。

questions.prompt: “Pollination affects only fruit-tree production, not other crops.”
questions.translation: 授粉只影響果樹生產，不影響其他作物。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph D第一句：

“Floral scent has a strong impact on the economic success of many agricultural crops that rely on insect pollinators, including fruit trees such as the bee-pollinated cherry, apple, apricot and peach, as well as vegetables and tropical plants such as papaya.”
中文意思：
花香對許多依賴昆蟲授粉的農作物的經濟成功有很大影響，包括由蜜蜂授粉的櫻桃、蘋果、杏和桃等果樹，以及蔬菜和木瓜等熱帶植物。
最後一句：
“This problem has been exacerbated by recent disease epidemics that have killed many honeybees, the major insect pollinators in the United States.”
中文意思：
近年的疾病流行殺死了許多蜜蜂，而蜜蜂是美國主要的昆蟲授粉者，這使問題更加嚴重。
題目定位詞是 “only fruit-tree production”、“not other crops”。Paragraph D 第一枝句已列出 fruit trees, vegetables, tropical plants。
關鍵證據：
“Pollination affects not only crop yield but also the quality and efficiency of crop production.”
中文意思：
授粉不只影響作物產量，也影響作物生產的品質和效率。
再配合第一句：
“including fruit trees ... as well as vegetables and tropical plants such as papaya.”
中文意思：
包括果樹，以及蔬菜和木瓜等熱帶植物。
題目說 “only fruit-tree production, not other crops”，但原文清楚把 vegetables 和 tropical plants也包括在內。這是直接衝突，所以答案是 FALSE。
Paragraph D 確實列出很多 fruit trees，學生可能停在 cherry, apple, apricot, peach。要繼續讀
“as well as vegetables and tropical plants such as papaya”。

questions.answer: B — Wasps lay eggs inside caterpillars.
questions.answerKey: B — Wasps lay eggs inside caterpillars.
questions.prompt: “How do wasps protect plants after being attracted by their scents?”
questions.translation: 黃蜂被植物氣味吸引後，如何保護植物？

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph C第一句：
“Herbivore-induced volatiles often serve as indirect defences.”
中文意思：
由食草動物誘發的揮發物經常作為間接防衛。
最後一句：
“It appears that methyl salicylate is both an attractant and a reward offered by the tree to get the ants to perform this valuable deterrent role.”
中文意思：
看來 methyl salicylate 既是吸引物，也是樹提供給螞蟻的獎勵，用來讓螞蟻執行這種有價值的嚇阻角色。
題目定位詞是 “wasps”、“protect plants”、“attracted by scents”。Paragraph C 有 “parasitic wasps can detect the volatile signature of a damaged plant”。
關鍵證據：

“For example, some parasitic wasps can detect the volatile signature of a damaged plant and will lay their eggs inside the offending caterpillar; eventually, the wasp eggs hatch, and the emerging larvae feed on the caterpillar from the inside out.”
中文意思：
例如，有些寄生蜂能偵測受損植物的揮發物特徵，並把卵產在造成傷害的毛蟲體內；最後，蜂卵孵化，新出現的幼蟲會從內部吃掉毛蟲。
A “Plants induce wasps to prey on herbivores.”這句方向大致接近，但動作太概括。題目問 wasps 怎樣保護植物，原文具體機制是產卵在毛蟲體內。
B “Wasps lay eggs inside caterpillars.”正確。這直接對應 “lay their eggs inside the offending caterpillar”。
C “Wasps lay eggs on plants to repel herbivores.”錯在位置和功能。原文是 inside caterpillar，沒有說 on plants。
D “The caterpillars and wasp eggs coexist successfully.”原文說幼蟲從內部吃毛蟲，令毛蟲生長變慢，沒有共存成功。
A 很吸引，因為它講到 wasps 和 herbivores，但 IELTS MCQ 要選最精準的原文動作。B 抓住inside caterpillar 這個決定性細節。

questions.prompt: “What caused the decline in honeybee numbers in the United States?”
questions.translation: 美國蜜蜂數量下降的原因是什麼？

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph D第一句：

“Floral scent has a strong impact on the economic success of many agricultural crops that rely on insect pollinators, including fruit trees such as the bee-pollinated cherry, apple, apricot and peach, as well as vegetables and tropical plants such as papaya.”
中文意思：
花香對許多依賴昆蟲授粉的農作物的經濟成功有很大影響，包括果樹、蔬菜和熱帶植物。
最後一句：
“This problem has been exacerbated by recent disease epidemics that have killed many honeybees, the major insect pollinators in the United States.”
中文意思：
近年的疾病流行殺死了許多蜜蜂，而蜜蜂是美國主要的昆蟲授粉者，這使問題更加嚴重。
題目定位詞是 “decline in honeybee numbers”、“United States”。Paragraph D 最後一句有honeybees 和 United States。
關鍵證據：
“recent disease epidemics that have killed many honeybees”
中文意思：
近年的疾病流行殺死了許多蜜蜂。
A “A reduction in pollination”這是可能後果，不是殺死蜜蜂的原因。
B “The spread of disease”正確。disease epidemics 對應 spread of disease。
C “Poisonous crops”原文沒有說有毒作物導致蜜蜂死亡。
D “Neglect by growers”原文沒有說種植者疏忽。
題目問 cause。原文的 disease epidemics 是原因；pollination problem 是背景和後果，不要把因果倒轉。

questions.answer: C — It requires extensive manual labour.
questions.answerKey: C — It requires extensive manual labour.
questions.prompt: “Which drawback of artificial fragrance is NOT mentioned in the passage?”
questions.translation: 以下哪一項人工香味的缺點沒有在文章中提到？

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph E第一句：
“One way in which plant breeders circumvent the pollination problem is to breed self-compatible, or apomictic, varieties that do not require fertilisation.”
中文意思：
植物育種者避開授粉問題的一種方法，是培育自我相容或無融合生殖的品種，這些品種不需要受精。
最後一句：
“Moreover, the metabolic engineering of fragrance could increase crop protection against pathogens and pests.”
中文意思：
此外，香味的代謝工程也可能提升作物對病原體和害蟲的保護。
題目定位詞是 “artificial fragrance”、“drawback”、“NOT mentioned”。Paragraph E 有 “spraying scent compounds on orchard trees” 和一連串缺點。
關鍵證據：

“Some growers have attempted to enhance honeybee foraging by spraying scent compounds on orchard trees, but this approach was costly, had to be repeated, had potentially toxic effects on the soil or local biota, and, in the end, proved to be inefficient.”
中文意思：
有些種植者嘗試在果園樹上噴灑香味化合物來增加蜜蜂覓食，但這種方法成本高，需要重複進行，可能對土壤或當地生物群有毒性影響，最後也證明效率低。
再看：
“The poor effectiveness of this strategy probably reflects inherent limitations of the artificial, topically applied compounds, which clearly fail to convey the appropriate message to the bees.”
中文意思：
這種策略效果差，可能反映出人工、表面施用的化合物本身有限制；它們明顯未能向蜜蜂傳達合適訊息。
A “It is expensive.”有提到：costly。
B “It cannot convey the correct information.”有提到：fail to convey the appropriate message to the bees。
C “It requires extensive manual labour.”沒有提到。原文說 had to be repeated，但沒有說需要大量人手或大量人工勞動。
D “It can poison the local environment.”有提到：potentially toxic effects on the soil or local biota。
所以答案是 C。
“had to be repeated” 可能令人聯想到 labor，但文章沒有講 extensive manual labour。MCQ 問NOT mentioned 時，要分清原文明講的缺點和自己推想的成本。

questions.answer: D — Scent plays a significant role in the ornamental-plant industry.
questions.answerKey: D — Scent plays a significant role in the ornamental-plant industry.
questions.prompt: “What does the figure of $30 billion illustrate?”
questions.translation: $30 billion 這個數字用來說明什麼？

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph F第一句：
“Genetic manipulation of the scent will also benefit the floriculture industry.”
中文意思：
對香味進行基因操控也會惠及花卉產業。
最後一句：
“Similar experiments in tobacco used genes for other monoterpene synthases, such as the one that produces limonene, but gave similar results.”
中文意思：
在煙草上進行的類似實驗使用了其他單萜合成酶基因，例如產生 limonene 的基因，但結果相似。
題目定位詞是 “$30 billion”。Paragraph F 中直接找到 “worldwide value of more than $30 billion”。
關鍵證據：
“The loss of scent among ornamentals, which have a worldwide value of more than $30 billion, makes them important targets for the genetic manipulation of flower fragrance.”
中文意思：
觀賞植物的香味流失，使它們成為花香基因操控的重要目標；這類觀賞植物在全球價值超過 300億美元。
這個數字不是在說香味本身值 300 億美元，也沒有直接說基因操控一定帶來巨大利潤。它的功能是顯示 ornamentals 這個產業規模很大，因此香味流失是一個重要產業問題。
A “Desirable scents are easy to manufacture.”原文沒有說香味容易製造。
B “Traditional floriculture needs reform.”文章批評傳統育種犧牲香味，但 $30 billion 主要展示產業價值，不是改革口號。
C “Genetic manipulation can yield large profits.”這是可能推想，但文章沒有直接說能賺大錢。
D “Scent plays a significant role in the ornamental-plant industry.”正確。香味流失影響一個高價值產業，所以 scent 在觀賞植物產業中具有重要意義。
C 很吸引，因為 $30 billion 容易令人想到 profits。可是原文只用它支持 “important targets”，沒有承諾 genetic manipulation 會帶來多少收益。

questions.answer: A — The linalool level may be too low for the human nose to detect.

questions.prompt: “What is one weakness of genetic experiments on fragrance?”
questions.translation: 香味基因實驗其中一個弱點是什麼？

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph F第一句：
“Genetic manipulation of the scent will also benefit the floriculture industry.”
中文意思：
對香味進行基因操控也會惠及花卉產業。
最後一句：
“Similar experiments in tobacco used genes for other monoterpene synthases, such as the one that produces limonene, but gave similar results.”
中文意思：
在煙草上進行的類似實驗使用了其他單萜合成酶基因，例如產生 limonene 的基因，但結果相似。
題目定位詞是 “weakness”、“genetic experiments”、“fragrance”。Paragraph F 有 “These experiments are still preliminary” 和 “below the threshold of detection for the human nose”。
關鍵證據：

“These experiments are still preliminary: For technical reasons, the gene was expressed everywhere in the plant, and although the transgenic plants did create small amounts of linalool, the level was below the threshold of detection for the human nose.”
中文意思：
這些實驗仍屬初步階段：基於技術原因，該基因在植物全身表達；雖然轉基因植物確實產生了少量 linalool，但其水平低於人類鼻子能偵測到的門檻。
A “The linalool level may be too low for the human nose to detect.”正確。這直接對應 “below the threshold of detection for the human nose”。
B “The experiments have made no progress.”原文說 some work has already begun，而且 created plants，所以並非完全沒有進展。
C “Tobacco is always a better experimental plant.”原文只說 similar experiments in tobacco，沒有比較 tobacco 一定較好。
D “The resulting scent is too intense.”原文方向相反，香味低到人鼻聞不到，不是太強烈。
“did create small amounts of linalool” 可能令人以為實驗成功。要繼續讀後半句：level was below the threshold of detection。真正弱點在於產生量太低，實際香味效果不足。

paragraphOverview.title: 全文 Skim Roadmap
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: 只看第一句，A 段先把 scented flowers 和 floral odours attract pollinators 連起來，說明一般人熟悉花香與授粉者之間的關係。最後一句再把不同花香和不同昆蟲聯繫起來：吸引 moths and butterflies 的氣味偏 “sweet”，吸引 certain flies 的氣味偏 “rotten”。所以本段大概是文章的基本介紹段：先提出花香有助授粉這個常識，再提醒科學證據其實有限，同時擴展到植物一直釋放volatiles。

B 段第一句轉到 vegetative parts，即植物非花朵部分釋放 volatiles，並指出這些化學物的生理功能過去較少受科學家注意。最後一句講 tobacco volatiles 在日夜有不同組合，而且夜間混合物最能 repel H. virescens moths。只看首尾句可知，本段大概講植物受傷時釋放氣味作防衛，重點會落在 resin、terpenes、green leaf volatile，以及某些揮發物如何阻止昆蟲攻擊或產卵。

C 段第一句直接指出 herbivore-induced volatiles often serve as indirect defences，即受食草動物攻擊而產生的氣味常作間接防衛。最後一句說 methyl salicylate 既吸引 ants，也作為 reward，令 ants 替樹執行 deterrent role。只看首尾句可見，本段功能是講「植物氣味如何召喚幫手」：植物未必直接殺死害蟲，卻可吸引 wasps、parasites、ants 等天敵保護自己。

D 段第一句把 floral scent 放到農業和經濟語境，指出很多依賴昆蟲授粉的 crops，包括 fruit trees、vegetables 和 papaya，都受花香影響。最後一句提到 disease epidemics killed many honeybees，令問題惡化。只看首尾句可知，本段大概講花香、授粉、農作物產量和授粉者減少之間的關係。若題目問 crop yield、pollination、honeybees、fruit quality 或 disease epidemics，本段很可能是目標段。

E 段第一句提出植物育種者解決 pollination problem 的方法：培育 self-compatible 或 apomictic varieties，讓植物不必依賴 fertilisation。最後一句轉到 metabolic engineering of fragrance，說它可能增加 crop protection against pathogens and pests。只看首尾句，本段會比較舊方法和新策略：自我繁殖品種、人工噴香味化合物、以及用 genetic engineering 加強花香。重點不只在授粉，也延伸到保護作物、控制授粉者拜訪頻率和病蟲害防禦。

F 段第一句說 genetic manipulation of scent 也會 benefit the floriculture industry，明顯轉向觀賞植物市場。最後一句提到 tobacco experiments 使用其他 monoterpene synthases genes，但得到similar results。只看首尾句可推測，本段主要講花卉產業中香味消失的問題，以及已有基因實驗的初步結果。它會涉及 ornamentals、cut flowers、petunia、carnation、linalool synthase、limonene，以及實驗弱點，例如香味產量低到人鼻不能偵測。

G 段只有一句，因此第一句也是最後一句。這句說下一代實驗已在進行，會用 sophisticated schemes 把 scent genes 的表達精準定位到 flowers 或其他 organs，例如能儲存 antimicrobial 或herbivore-repellent compounds 的特殊腺體。只看這一句可知，G 段是前文基因實驗的未來發展方向。它不再講舊實驗結果，重點轉到更精準的 organ-specific expression 和更實用的防病、防食草動物策略。 Answer Key Questio Answer n 1 B 2 A 3 F 4 C 5 TRUE 6 NOT GIVEN 7 TRUE 8 FALSE 9 B 10 B 11 C 12 D 13 A
